description_en: Retrieves node group information by node group ID by calling GetNodeGroup
description_zh: 调用GetNodeGroup根据节点分组ID获取节点分组信息
name: GetNodeGroup

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the nodes in the node group. This value is consistent with the mode specified in the associated join permission credential
ClassMode.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的一致

CreateMillis.description_en: The creation time of the node group. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateMillis.description_zh: 节点分组的创建时间，格式为 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

DataDispatchConfig.description_en: The data forwarding configuration of the node group
DataDispatchConfig.description_zh: 节点分组的数据流转配置

Destination.description_en:
The data forwarding destination. Valid values:

IOT: forwards data to an IoT Platform product.
ONS: forwards data to an MQ topic
Destination.description_zh:
数据流转目的地。取值：

IOT：数据流转到 IoT 的产品。
ONS：数据流转到 MQ 的 Topic

IotProduct.description_en: The product information. This field is returned if the forwarding destination is an IoT Platform product
IotProduct.description_zh: 如果流转目的地是IoT产品，该字段存储产品信息

ProductType.description_en:
The product type. Valid values:

IOT_SUITE: forwards data to IoT Suite Basic Edition.
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR: forwards data to IoT Suite Pro Edition
ProductType.description_zh:
产品类型。取值：

IOT_SUITE：数据流转到IoT套件基础版。
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR：数据流转到IoT套件高级版

OnsTopics.description_en: The MQ topic information. This field is returned if the forwarding destination is MQ
OnsTopics.description_zh: 如果流转目的地是MQ, 该字段存储MQ Topic信息

DownlinkRegionName.description_en: The region ID of the MQ downlink topic

UplinkRegionName.description_en: The region ID of the MQ uplink topic

DataDispatchEnabled.description_en: The enabled or disabled status of data forwarding for the node group. A value of true indicates enabled, and a value of false indicates disabled
DataDispatchEnabled.description_zh: 节点分组的数据流转启停状态，true表示启用，false表示停用

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by the nodes in the node group. This value is consistent with the frequency band specified in the associated join permission credential
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所采用的频段的频段ID，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的一致

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the nodes in the node group. This value is consistent with the JoinEUI specified in the associated join permission credential
JoinEui.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所使用的JoinEUI，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的JoinEUI一致

JoinPermissionEnabled.description_en: The enabled or disabled status of the join permission credential associated with the node group. A value of true indicates enabled, and a value of false indicates disabled
JoinPermissionEnabled.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的启停状态，true表示启用，false表示停用

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The ID of the join permission credential associated with the node group
JoinPermissionId.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的ID

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission credential associated with the node group
JoinPermissionName.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的名称

JoinPermissionOwnerAliyunId.description_en:
If the associated credential is a dedicated join permission, this field indicates the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the credential owner.
If the associated credential is a roaming join permission, this field is always set to AliCloud IoT
JoinPermissionOwnerAliyunId.description_zh:
如果关联的是专用入网凭证，该字段表示入网凭证的拥有者的阿里云账号ID。
如果关联的是泛在入网凭证，该字段的值恒为AliCloud IoT

JoinPermissionType.description_en:
The type of the join permission credential associated with the node group. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated credential.
ROAMING: roaming credential
JoinPermissionType.description_zh:
与节点分组关联的入网凭证类型。取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证
ROAMING：泛在凭证

Locks.description_en: The list of operation locks associated with the node group
Locks.description_zh: 节点分组所关联的操作锁列表

CreateMillis.description_en: The creation time of the lock

Enabled.description_en: The enabled or disabled status of the lock

LockType.description_en: The type of the lock. Valid values: WRITE, which indicates that all write operations are locked, including editing and deletion
LockType.description_zh: 锁的类型。取值：WRITE，所有写操作都加锁，包括编辑、删除等

NodeGroupName.description_en: The name of the node group

NodesCnt.description_en: The number of nodes in the node group
NodesCnt.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点数量

RxDailySum.description_en: The number of uplink packets for the current day associated with the join permission credential linked to the node group
RxDailySum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当天上行数据包量

RxMonthSum.description_en: The number of uplink packets for the current month associated with the join permission credential linked to the node group
RxMonthSum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当月上行数据包量

TxDailySum.description_en: The number of downlink packets for the current day associated with the join permission credential linked to the node group
TxDailySum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当天下行数据包量

TxMonthSum.description_en: The number of downlink packets for the current month associated with the join permission credential linked to the node group
TxMonthSum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当月下行数据包量

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
